summary: @servicetitan/cp-ui preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. On `npm install`, setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (bun-v1.3.13) into a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a bundled ~727KB file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io fingerprints: hex-named globals, large numeric/string constant table `n7gIxM`, string-array rotator `WV8StW`, decoder `hc1jfK9`) so its behavior is hidden from readers of the tarball. The package presents itself as a React UI component library, which has no legitimate need for an alternate JavaScript runtime or an obfuscated 727KB blob executed at install time. The use of Bun rather than Node also causes the payload to run outside Node-focused install-time inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
